conflict_resolutions.PARTIAL_OR_QUALIFIED_CHANGE_REQUIRES_CLA: Resolved only as to current status by the identified later source’s express revocation of the parent order as amended, effective 1999-09-30. This does not establish whether the amended commission had already terminated earlier; its triggering report submission (and any extension) is unproved.

rationale: Provisional NO as of 2026-10-14: EO:13138 §3(b), §9 expressly lists EO 13038 as amended by EO 13102 among committees whose work is completed and establishes revocation effective September 30, 1999. Earlier first cessation is unresolved: EO 13038 §4 says termination 30 days after actual report submission unless extended by President. The amended section 2 reporting deadline is December 31, 1998. Actual report submission date and any extension are not established by sources reviewed. Read later order text and exact held original; status conclusion is separate from whole-lifecycle conclusion.
